residents.name: Mara Velez
residents.household: Mara and Julian are a long-term couple who share the apartment but sleep in separate bedrooms: Mara sleeps in the first bedroom and Julian sleeps in the second, which also serves as his office. Mara works mostly from home as an editor, while Julian commutes to a museum and uses the apartment's large living room for occasional evening project work.
